# Demo Selenium TypeScript for NHS Wales

> A beginner-friendly walkthrough of Selenium WebDriver browser automation in
> TypeScript, driving a real Chrome browser against the live production NHS
> Wales website and running three real assertion-based checks.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md): Install, run, and troubleshooting instructions.
- [Spec](./spec/index.md): Single source of truth for the exact three test
  scenarios, selectors, and expected strings checked against nhs.wales.
- [Citation](./CITATION.cff): How to cite this software.

## Source

- [demo.ts](./src/demo.ts): The Selenium WebDriver demo script itself.

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Instructions for AI coding agents working in
  this repo.
